failure_symptoms: Two independent faults: snapshot() hands out the live internal stock array (a caller's push leaks back in), and an order that is paid but not shipped already reads as complete.

f2p: returns a copy that does not alias internal stock
is complete only when the order is both paid and shipped
p2p: is complete when paid and shipped

tell_audit.notes: Both diffs are one-token changes (spread dropped, && to ||) and a reader can name each. Hard tier is carried by having to find and fix two independent faults, not by concealment.
